services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Our boat tours around Manhattan offer an incredible and unique way to take in the beauty, size and diversity of Manhattan's architecture and sights. Everything you see on the downtown loop plus a magnificent look at the Empire State, Chrysler, UN buildings, Yankee Stadium, the Cloisters, all of the city's famed bridges and more. Take a boat ride around Manhattan with New York Harbor Tours. It is easily the best way to see all of the sights in a single experience, including the Statue of Liberty, the downtown skyline, Freedom Tower, the Brooklyn Bridge, the East River, the Empire State and Chrysler buildings, the UN Building, Harlem River, Palisades and more. services.name: Boat Rental For July 4th
services.desc: Join us for a memorable 3-hour evening cruise and a private front-row seat for the Macy’s 4th of July fireworks show. See the Macy’s 4th of July fireworks show from the deck of your own private boat. New York Harbor Tours offer fourth of July cruises for groups of up to 6 people. blurb: New York Harbor Tours offers private and small group boat tours around New York Harbor and Manhattan. Guests see landmarks like the Statue of Liberty, Brooklyn Bridge, Ellis Island, and the Manhattan skyline. Tours are intimate, with boats seating 6 or 16 guests, and include options for corporate events, family outings, and special occasions.
